complaint: The cleaner shouted at me when I asked him to mop the spill near our table.
The waiter yelled at my child and threw the menu on the table.
The security guard was extremely rude and argued with me about where I parked.
The branch manager insulted my family and refused to listen to my complaint.
The assistant branch manager lied to us about a refund and was very dismissive.
The head chef screamed at me in front of other customers when I asked about allergens.
My server brought me a steak I asked well done and it was completely raw.
Someone at the entrance forgot our reservation and made us wait 40 minutes with no apology.
Our table had crumbs and a sticky menu left from the earlier party.
The espresso machine at the cafe corner was producing bitter and watery coffee all week.
Kitchen staff are repeatedly serving undercooked chicken and the hygiene is a food safety risk.
The delivery rider was rude and threw the bag at my door.
